name: Yes - I guess so = Approved Request
subject: Request Approved
body:
Thank you for the request. I have reviewed the requirement and discussed the associated workload and priorities with my team. Based on our current resources and mission requirements, we are able to support the request.

We will coordinate internally to ensure the requirement is properly planned and executed while continuing to meet our existing responsibilities. I will provide updates as we make progress and will communicate any issues that may affect the anticipated timeline.

Please let me know if there are any additional details, constraints, or expectations that should be considered as we move forward.

name: WTF NO - Unable to Support
subject: Request Status
body:
Thank you for the request. After reviewing the requirement and considering our current workload, priorities, and available resources, I am unable to support this request at this time.

Our current commitments prevent us from taking on this additional requirement without negatively affecting existing mission priorities and established timelines.

I understand the importance of the request and appreciate the opportunity to review it. If the requirement remains a priority, I recommend discussing potential adjustments to the scope, timeline, or competing priorities to determine whether an alternative approach may be feasible.

Please let me know if you would like to discuss potential options or alternative courses of action.

name: Yeah that will have to wait - Need More Time
subject: Request Timeline
body:
Thank you for the request. I will need additional time to complete this requirement properly.

Based on the current scope of the requirement and our existing workload, additional time will allow us to complete the task thoroughly while maintaining the quality of our other ongoing responsibilities.

I recommend adjusting the requested timeline to allow sufficient time for planning, coordination, and execution. This will help ensure the requirement is completed effectively without creating unnecessary impacts to other established priorities.

I will provide an updated timeline once I have had an opportunity to assess the remaining work and available resources.

name: With who? Insufficient Manpower
subject: Resource Constraints
body:
Given current staffing levels and existing priorities, we do not currently have sufficient manpower to support this requirement within the requested timeline.

Our team is currently balancing existing mission-critical requirements with ongoing operational responsibilities. Taking on this additional requirement with our current staffing levels would create a significant risk to our ability to meet established priorities and timelines.

If this requirement remains a priority, I recommend discussing potential adjustments to the scope, timeline, or existing tasking. Another option may be to identify additional personnel or organizational resources that could assist with execution.

I am available to discuss the current workload and potential options for moving forward.

name: Not our job - Outside Responsibilities
subject: Request Clarification
body:
After reviewing the requirement, I do not believe this falls within my current area of responsibility.

I want to ensure the request is addressed by the appropriate organization or individual with the necessary authority, expertise, and resources to provide the required support.

I recommend coordinating with the appropriate stakeholder or organizational element to determine responsibility for this requirement. If needed, I am available to assist with identifying the appropriate point of contact or facilitating the initial coordination.

Please let me know if additional information is required from my team to support that coordination.

name: That's a dumb Idea - Recommend Alternative
subject: Recommended Approach
body:
I understand the intent behind the proposed approach. However, I have some concerns regarding its feasibility and potential impact on existing requirements and priorities.

Based on the current information available, I recommend considering alternative approaches that may provide a more effective and sustainable path toward achieving the desired outcome.

I believe a discussion with the appropriate stakeholders would be beneficial to compare potential courses of action, identify any associated risks, and determine the most appropriate way forward.

Please let me know when is a good date and time to discuss other avenues for success.

name: We need to talk - Discuss Offline
subject: Follow-Up Discussion
body:
I believe this matter would be better addressed through a separate discussion with the appropriate stakeholders.

A direct discussion would provide an opportunity to clarify the requirement, address any outstanding questions, and ensure that all relevant parties have a common understanding of the issue and desired outcome.

Rather than continuing the discussion through email, I recommend coordinating a separate meeting or discussion with the appropriate stakeholders to work through the details and identify the best way forward.

Please let me know your availability, and I will coordinate as appropriate.

name: WTF - Request Clarification
subject: Additional Information Required
body:
Thank you for the request. I would appreciate some additional clarification regarding the requirement before proceeding.

Additional information regarding the desired outcome, scope, timeline, priorities, and any applicable constraints would help ensure that the requirement is properly understood before work begins.

Providing this information will allow us to better assess the requirement, determine the appropriate level of support, and identify any potential issues that may affect execution.

Please provide the additional details when available, and I will review the information and determine the appropriate way forward.
